literal: The Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors ruled with leniency; their beneficence reached Han and Tang.
idiomatic: The ancient sage-kings were gentle; their grace extended through Han and Tang.

literal: Cherishing life and hating killing became habit and nature.
idiomatic: Love of life and hatred of killing were second nature.

literal: Even in the extreme disorder of the Five Dynasties, those practiced in battle were only a few men.
idiomatic: Even Five Dynasties chaos produced few habitual warriors.

literal: Song prevailed through culture, yet Liao frontier defense still weighed more on the Southern Face, simply because that region was vast and populous.
idiomatic: Song won by civil culture, but Liao still stressed the southern frontier because of its size and population.

literal: In the end, through cherishing benevolence and good neighborliness, war drums were silent for nearly two hundred years.
idiomatic: Finally, benevolence and good neighbors kept the drums quiet for nearly two centuries.

literal: This is why Liao was admirable indeed.
idiomatic: That was Liao's glory.
